<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from '$lib/components/ui/button';
  import {
    Card,
    CardFrame,
    CardFrameDescription,
    CardFrameHeader,
    CardFrameTitle,
    CardPanel
  } from '$lib/components/ui/card';
  import { Field, FieldLabel } from '$lib/components/ui/field';
  import { Form } from '$lib/components/ui/form';
  import { Input } from '$lib/components/ui/input';
  import {
    Select,
    SelectItem,
    SelectPopup,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue
  } from '$lib/components/ui/select';

  const frameworkOptions = [
    { label: 'Next.js', value: 'next' },
    { label: 'Vite', value: 'vite' },
    { label: 'Remix', value: 'remix' },
    { label: 'Astro', value: 'astro' }
  ] as const;
</script>

<CardFrame class="w-full max-w-xs">
  <CardFrameHeader>
    <CardFrameTitle>Create project</CardFrameTitle>
    <CardFrameDescription>Deploy your new project in one-click.</CardFrameDescription>
  </CardFrameHeader>
  <Card>
    <CardPanel>
      <Form class="flex w-full flex-col gap-4">
        <Field>
          <FieldLabel>Name</FieldLabel>
          <Input placeholder="Name of your project" type="text" />
        </Field>
        <Field>
          <FieldLabel>Framework</FieldLabel>
          <Select value="next">
            <SelectTrigger>
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectPopup>
              {#each frameworkOptions as { label, value } (value)}
                <SelectItem {value} {label} />
              {/each}
            </SelectPopup>
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Button class="w-full" type="submit">Deploy</Button>
      </Form>
    </CardPanel>
  </Card>
</CardFrame>
